_comment: Deploy.ps1 settings. Copy to settings.json and update values. Passwords are never stored here: pass -ServicePassword / -CertPassword to Deploy.ps1. Full reference: docs/Installation.md#settings-reference
_comment1: Windows service name to create. Default WebJEA.
_comment2: Every host name the site answers on; the certificate must cover all of them.
_comment3: Account the service runs as (scripts execute as this account). gMSA recommended (trailing $). For a regular account, pass its password with -ServicePassword.
_comment5: HTTP listener port, or 0 to disable. Redirects to HTTPS automatically when HttpsPort is also set.
_comment6: HTTPS listener port, or 0 to disable. Requires CertSubject or CertPath (set exactly one, leave the other empty).
_comment7: Certificate in the machine store: text contained in the subject of a LocalMachine\My certificate (with private key) covering every SiteFQDN, e.g. the CN. The match that expires last is served, so a renewal is used after the next service restart. Best for internal CA / autoenrollment certificates.
_comment7a: Certificate in a PFX file: full path, in a folder of its own (e.g. C:\webjea\tls\webjea.pfx). Kestrel reloads it when it changes, so ACME renewals need no restart. Pass a password-protected PFX's password with -CertPassword. See docs/Certificate-Renewal.md.
_comment8: Folder the release's site files are copied to.
_comment9: Folder for WebJEA scripts and webjea.json. Starter scripts are copied only if it has no webjea.json (or legacy config.json), and never overwrite existing files.
_comment10: Folder for the application and usage logs.
_comment11: Application log file name, in LogPath.
_comment12: Simplified usage log file name, in LogPath (importable into Excel).
